newsitem.title: USA: AOL lower amid marketing plan rumors.
newsitem.headline: AOL lower amid marketing plan rumors.

text.p: Stock of America Online sank to a new year low Monday amid rumors about the company's recently announced $100 million marketing push that were swiftly denied by the company.

Shares of the world's largest online service tumbled 2-1/4 to 27 before bouncing back to 27-3/8 midday on volume of almost two million shares. The stock hit 35-1/2 Sept 30 when the marketing plan was announced. AOL has more than six million members.
Analysts mentioned several rumors driving the stock down, but an AOL spokeswoman denied the substance of the charges.
